versions.changelog:
- Initial release of AI Code Review Assistant skill for the AstronClaw platform.
- Automates multi-dimensional code review, including code quality, security, and performance analysis.
- Provides personalized AI-driven suggestions using the iFlytek Spark API.
- Offers five core tools: comprehensive review, quality scan, security audit, performance analysis, and report generation (Markdown/HTML/JSON).
- Supports configuration for review levels, AI provider, and environment setup.
- Includes quick start guide, usage examples, testing instructions, and development pathways for extensibility.
